clues: This city sits on the south bank of a broad river. It lies in the east of Canada, in New Brunswick.
Extensive snow falls here every year. In this region, a heavy fall of snow is a yearly fact.
Set on the south bank of its river, this city was made an official town in 1889.
Each summer, wealthy sport fishers flock to this river valley. They come to chase the famed Atlantic salmon.
Sugarloaf Provincial Park is this town's winter playground. Its slopes host both downhill and cross country skiing.
